title: Copier Service Inspection Checklist
subtitle: Copier And Multifunction-Device Service: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Copier Service Inspection Checklist covers copier, feeder, print engine, finishing unit, network interface, and supply system. The office equipment coordinator records Copier And Multifunction-Device Service criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Copier Service Inspection Checklist keeps Copier And Multifunction-Device Service exceptions visible until the office equipment coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Copier Service Inspection Checklist at device location, supply area, network point, and affected workgroup. Document copier, feeder, print engine, finishing unit, network interface, and supply system identity before Copier And Multifunction-Device Service begins. Compare copier, feeder, print engine, finishing unit, network interface, and supply system findings with stated Copier And Multifunction-Device Service criteria; route unresolved Copier And Multifunction-Device Service issues to qualified office-equipment service reviewer.

sections.title: Inspection scope and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Copier And Multifunction-Device Service, identify responsible parties, device location, supply area, network point, and affected workgroup, and the linked copier, feeder, print engine, finishing unit, network interface, and supply system source.

fields.label: Asset tag, make, model, serial, and meter count
Fault code, tray, paper, media, and finishing configuration

sections.title: Checklist findings and inspection checks
sections.guidance: Capture Copier And Multifunction-Device Service facts for copier, feeder, print engine, finishing unit, network interface, and supply system; include result, limit, source, and next control.

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

blocks.label: Copier And Multifunction-Device Service inspection checks
items: Print, copy, scan, feed, duplex, and finish result
Jam location, roller, feeder, tray, and paper-path condition
Image quality, registration, density, and defect pattern
Supply, waste container, and consumable status
Network, address-book, authentication, and scan destination behavior
Safety label, cover, interlock, power, and heat-area condition

sections.title: Deficiencies, inspection decision, and follow-up
sections.guidance: List each unresolved Copier And Multifunction-Device Service finding with its restriction, correction owner, and reinspection trigger. Office Equipment Coordinator records reviewer disposition.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Heat, odor, smoke, electrical, or damaged-cord concern
Firmware or network change lacks authorization
Required function cannot be restored or isolated
blocks.guidance: Pause Copier And Multifunction-Device Service when an electrical, heat, privacy, authorization, or failed-function concern remains. Retain the available Copier And Multifunction-Device Service proof and route unresolved copier, feeder, print engine, finishing unit, network interface, and supply system scope to office equipment coordinator.
